plugins.cameraPermission: Ask Nearby uses the camera so you can photograph or film what you were sent to check, and to set your profile picture.
plugins.microphonePermission: Ask Nearby records audio with your video so you can say the date and describe what you are seeing.
plugins.photosPermission: Ask Nearby opens your library only so you can choose a profile picture. Job evidence is always taken with the camera.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Ask Nearby uses your location to confirm you reached the place you were sent to check.
